provenance.method: lesson notes written from the NERDC 2025 scheme of work outline; every week keeps its scheme topic and bullets as the teaching spine

topics.title: Letter Gg
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to state the sound of G
The pupils should be able to trace capital G
The pupils should be able to trace small g

Introduction:
Today we learn letter Gg. We know some letters already.
G makes a sound like in the word goat.

Content:
G says guh guh guh like in goat. Look at this goat picture.
Capital G is tall with a curve. Trace it in the air.
Small g is like a fish hook. Trace it in the sand.

Class activity:
Let's trace G with our fingers on the table.
We will say guh guh guh while tracing.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does G make?
Show me capital G.
Trace small g in your book.

Summary:
G says guh guh guh like in goat.

topics.title: Letters Aa to Ll
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to say the sounds of A to L
The pupils should be able to find called letters
The pupils should be able to trace favorite letters

Introduction:
We learned letters A to L. Let's remember them all.
We will play games with these letters today.

Content:
Say each sound from A to L. A says ah B says buh and so on.
Find the letter when the teacher calls its name.
Trace your favorite letters in your book.

Class activity:
We will stand up when our letter is called.
Then we will trace our favorite letters on the board.

Evaluation questions:
What sound does A make?
Show me the letter called by teacher.
Which letter do you like most?

Summary:
We know all letters from A to L now.

topics.title: Revision and matching
topics.content:
Behavioural objectives:
The pupils should be able to match capital to small letters
The pupils should be able to match letters to pictures
The pupils should be able to sing the letter song

Introduction:
We learned many letters. Let's play games with them.
We will match letters and sing songs.

Content:
Match capital letters to small letters. A matches a.
Match letters to pictures. A matches apple picture.
Sing the letter song from A to Z.

Class activity:
We will play matching game with cards.
Then we will sing the letter song with actions.

Evaluation questions:
Match A to its small letter.
Which picture matches letter B?
Sing the letter song.

Summary:
We can match letters and sing the alphabet song.
